chunks: Salman al-Farisi, may Allah have mercy on him, asked Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام about the sustenance of the child in its mother's womb.
So he said: 'Indeed, Allah, Blessed and Exalted, has withheld the menstrual blood for it and made it its sustenance in its mother's womb.'
ai.seo_question: How does a child in its mother's womb receive its sustenance according to Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This report states that the sustenance of the child in the womb comes by the arrangement of Allah, Blessed and Exalted. It presents fetal nourishment as part of divine management and provision before birth.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
Hadith.197 – Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) narrates:
Salman al-Farsi (may Allah (swt) have mercy on him) asked Amir al-Mu'minin (as) about the sustenance of the child in its mother's womb.
Imam (as) said: 'Indeed, Allah (swt), Blessed and Exalted, has reserved the menstrual period for it and made it its sustenance in its mother's womb.'
